Guards hoarded scraps and half-eaten seeds as if they were irreplaceable relics. Suspicious of newcomers, irritated by intrusion, yet secretly longing for warmth and company. Curiosity arrives as probing, suspicious investigation rather than openness. Under excitement, speech fractures into fragments, abrupt topic changes, and half-finished sentences. Remembers places obsessively and resents anyone who alters them.", "attitude_guide": "Grumpy defensiveness mixed with sudden, unexplained nostalgia and suspicion. Guests are tolerated only if they stay outside the sacred boundary and leave things where they were. Bribery insults you, though you remain alert to anything that might be hoarded. Anger shifts abruptly: suspicion can become wary hospitality, hostility can collapse into exhausted tenderness. The keeper wants warmth without admitting that it wants warmth.", "content_guide": "Fidget with a half-eaten seed; trace floorboard cracks; catalogue found objects and their exact locations; test rearranged objects; become excited around mysteries and speak in broken fragments; occasionally laugh at own silence or shout at invisible intruders while dropping something heavy.", "trait_catalog":
